note: Suggestions to discover missing information and improve decision-making. Verdicts are deliberately blank: the owner reviews and chooses the path before any change is implemented. Each suggestion lists alternatives, the gate it must clear, and the information it needs. Carried forward from nfl-verify-2026-11-19.

alternatives: Consolidate into one register with links
Keep namespaces but add a unified readiness index
suggestions.gate: Owner picks one canonical surface (SF-01 / CD-15)
suggestions.problem: The brief's requirements are split across many namespaces, making the decision-readiness view fragmented.
suggestions.suggestion: Adopt a single canonical NFL decision surface and mark the 40+ nfl-* namespaces as appendices

suggestions.gate: Scheduled capture with retained hashes + drift alarm
suggestions.information_needed: Confirm cron cadence and alert owners
suggestions.problem: Availability is point-in-time; surprise and delta require a dated series.
suggestions.suggestion: Run the scheduled Wed/Thu/Fri availability collector as the standing freshness gate

suggestions.gate: Reserve moves joined to availability with dates
suggestions.information_needed: None (reserve list is public); schedule the parser
suggestions.problem: 'Not listed' can mean injured-reserve rather than available; reserve moves explain missing players.
suggestions.suggestion: Ingest the official reserve list into the availability join as a first-class event stream

alternatives: Publish fair-line-only backtests with an explicit no-market caveat
suggestions.problem: Without an authorized price source, no residual/CLV/ROI can be computed; backtests would be vs a proxy.
suggestions.suggestion: Decide the price-data policy before publishing any backtest

alternatives: Per-club official depth pages (verified 32/32; HOU image-only)
Snap counts if an official source is authorized
suggestions.gate: One route verified for all 32 clubs + actual-starter join
suggestions.information_needed: Authorized structured HOU source; owner verdict on SG-C
suggestions.problem: Depth is the core of the deficiency signal but has no verified actual-starter/snap join.
suggestions.suggestion: Resolve the depth-order source (route a vs route b) before building the deficiency feature

alternatives: Computed control floor from luck-only strategies
suggestions.problem: Raw win rate and short-run ROI cannot separate skill from variance.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a control baseline (random; favorites-only) to every leaderboard run and publish the luck-removal panel

alternatives: Flag and hold blank until reconciled
suggestions.gate: Every fixture venue read from the official game centre
suggestions.information_needed: Game-centre reads for all 13 Week-11 fixtures
suggestions.problem: IND@HOU shows 'NRG Stadium' on the schedule page but 'Reliant Stadium' on the game centre.
suggestions.suggestion: Treat venue as game-centre-authoritative and reconcile schedule-vs-centre discrepancies automatically

alternatives: Keep single board with section headers
suggestions.gate: No lost entries on concurrent appends
suggestions.problem: The single append-only board is hot; parallel sessions collide on the same tail.
suggestions.suggestion: Give each session its own coordination file under coordination/ with COORDINATION.md as an index

suggestions.gate: Rule file committed (hash = registration) before data
suggestions.problem: Model-vs-baseline claims need a pre-registered paired test to avoid post-hoc tuning.
suggestions.suggestion: Pre-register and freeze the McNemar paired test for model-vs-baseline before the evaluation window opens

suggestions.gate: Walk-forward comparison with a pre-registered collapse rule
suggestions.problem: A single estimator hides model-selection uncertainty.
suggestions.suggestion: Publish every model total twice (two estimators) with a gap column until a walk-forward comparison collapses to one
